watches.name: Kruger ‘A’ FL
watches.description: LIGHTWEIGHT TACTICAL CHRONOGRAPH A versatile titanium tactical watch, built for bush tracking operations. Take the Kruger into the wild where it belongs. The Kruger pays tribute to the rangers of the Kruger region in Southern Africa. These men and women work tirelessly to protect some of the most endangered animals in the world, in extremely hostile and unforgiving environments. As such, the Kruger is built to handle some serious punishment , fulfilling its purpose no matter the challenge. On the case back is a deeply engraved image of a white rhino , cementing our commitment to anti-poaching. A portion of the profit from each watch will go towards supporting the rangers who work tirelessly to protect and defend rhinos in South Africa. Exceptionally light, functional and easy to read. These are the three elements that make the Kruger an outstanding tactical tool watch. Machined from grade 2 titanium with a 1200HV coating , the Kruger case is not only tough but also scratch-resistant. Now updated with drilled lugs for easier strap changing. As with all our watches, great consideration is given to designing a high-contrast, clear display. A double-domed sapphire crystal with inner and outer AR coating ensures excellent clarity outdoors with minimal glare. The dial is painted in rich matte black with Swiss Super-LumiNova for exceptional legibility. A fully luminous option is available for both versions ‘A’ and ‘B’. With multiple ceramic bezel insert options, the Kruger can be customised to your needs. Whether you require a countdown function, secondary timezone, or measuring elapsed time under an hour, there is an option for you. For V2 of the Kruger, the bezel mechanism has been modified for a 60-click bidirectional action . Each watch will come with a secondary single-pass olive nylon strap and will be packaged in an olive nylon MOLLE pouch , perfect for repurposing as a EDC pouch that can be attached to your belt or backpack.

watches.name: Tugela – Black
watches.description: Embrace the elements Designed to withstand harsh environments, the Tugela is a utilitarian timekeeper for those who tread the path less travelled. A bold, high-contrast and symmetrical dial design ensures you will stay on task, whatever your mission. With its aggressively angular case design and bead-blasted finish, it is the quintessential purpose-driven timing instrument. Our iconic 300m water-resistant watch, purpose-built for timing on land or sea. The tall bezel provides ample grip, while keeping in form with the overall case shape. The 120-click unidirectional bezel has a crisp, satisfying click, with no play. Up front, the dial is protected by an anti-reflective coated sapphire crystal, ensuring excellent clarity. Swiss Super-LumiNova paint applied directly to the dial keeps things clean and simple, with an easily recognisable 12h index during dark hours. On the back, you will find an engraved depiction of the Drakensberg mountains, with the Tugela River in the foreground. The 7mm crown is easy to operate thanks to its knurled grip, the tip signed with a luminous dragon logo. The watch comes in our new MOLLE pouch with a custom velcro patch. Edit: We are out of stock of the original seatbelt nylon strap. The last few Tugela Black will ship with a ribbed olive nylon strap, pictured above.

watches.name: Tugela GMT ‘Blue’
watches.description: Embark on a worldwide adventure Built like a tank, so you can tackle any obstacle in your path. The Tugela GMT is purpose-built for those who don’t just dream about exotic locations, but get out and experience them. The Tugela GMT packs all the elements that made our original dive watch so incredible and takes it to a whole new level. A double-domed crystal for minimal distortion, applied bead-blasted indices with super bright C3(X1) Super-LumiNova, a 5-link engineer bracelet, and of course, the GMT complication, so you can track multiple time zones. This is a pure tool watch, built for globetrotting. The GMT follows the original Tugela with the dial taking inspiration from the beadwork of the Zulu tribe, but now with applied bead-blasted indices. The case gets its tapered shape from the Protea flower, the bezel edges mimicking the petals. This tapered shape reduces the footprint on the wrist, making for a very comfortable fit, even for smaller wrists. On the case back you’ll find the stamped design of the Drakensberg mountains, with the Tugela river in the foreground. Under the hood is the workhorse NH34A automatic movement – tough and reliable. It’s a Japanese movement running at 21,600bph, with hacking and hand-winding features. The added GMT complication makes it possible to track a second, or even a third time zone. A 48-click bi-directional ball-bearing bezel provides a crisp and satisfying click, ensuring easy adjusting for any time zone. The aluminium insert is deeply engraved and filled with X1-C3 Swiss Super-LumiNova™ for ultimate night brightness. The engineer-style bracelet provides a more complex pattern on the wrist. A secondary nylon strap comes standard for a more casual look. Each watch will come packaged by default in a nylon MOLLE pouch – ideal for repurposing as a phone pocket, magazine pouch or hip flask holder.

watches.name: Aoraki – ‘Milspec’
watches.description: One purpose, infinite adventures The clean and concise design of the Milspec is exactly what you need for hassle-free legibility, day or night. Zero clutter for those accustomed to the simple things in life. Named after the font used for cockpit instruments of the F-14 fighter jet, the ‘Milspec’ takes design cues from the aviation instruments, with longer minute track markers and a clean minimalist handset. Aoraki represents a milestone for Draken as a watch brand. This was the first watch to be assembled locally in New Zealand and as such, we thought it appropriate to give it a Kiwi name. Aoraki (Mt Cook) is the tallest mountain in New Zealand and the proving ground for Edmund Hillary, the first person to climb Mount Everest. Since starting the brand, we have never outsourced our QC or shipping ensuring that customers get the highest quality timepiece at an affordable price. Assembling the watches locally means that we’ll have more control over the SKUs, improved sustainability and contribute to the local watchmaking community. The Aoraki is a first in a few other ways too. It’s our first watch with an antimagnetic case (20,000A/m), our first watch with a flat crystal, and our first watch with a brush-finished case. While the latter might not seem like a big deal, there was a bit of thinking that went into designing a case that still adheres to the Draken design language. For this model, we also designed 4 completely different dial/handset combinations. Each design tells a different story and has its own character. Swiss Super-LumiNova™ application is excellent as you would expect from Draken, and we’ve also upped the ante with the AR coating on the crystal. As with our other models, Viton™️ gaskets come standard and the watch will come with both a leather bund single pass strap, and a military-style nylon strap more suitable for water. The watch will come packaged in our MOLLE pouch with a custom patch of Aoraki Mountain (Mt Cook).

watches.name: Peregrine DLC ‘B’ White
watches.description: Inspired by aviation. Built for the outdoors Like the bird of its namesake, the Peregrine is streamlined for quick decisive manoeuvres. A bold handset and dial ensure unobstructed legibility, while the discreet power reserve indicator lets you know when power is running low. Taking its name from the bird of prey known for its extreme speed and agility, the Peregrine is a celebration of flight in the form of a functional, concise pilot watch. Six years since its initial launch, the 2024 edition has been completely redesigned for a more everyday wear experience. The precisely engineered case is streamlined into a clean and functional shape. A Viton™️ gasket on the case back provides extra longevity reducing service intervals. On the display, the dial features bold numerals, thick batons, and a clear minute track, contrast and clarity are at the fore. The handset is lifted straight from the Flieger ‘Type A’ design of WWII, with version B of the Peregrine featuring the same triangle dots of the aforementioned vintage inspiration. Purpose-built for a life of adventure, the Peregrine will be your ever-present companion as you tackle the great outdoors. The crown is now on the left, bringing the power reserve indicator (PRI) to the bottom of the dial. The PRI is subtly executed, red = empty, white = full. Above this is a neatly and symmetrically positioned date window, with luminous text for improved night legibility. The dial itself is finished in a deep black for maximum contrast, while the applied indices receive a healthy dose of C3(X1) Super-LumiNova. The other white markers and numerals are printed in Super-LumiNova BGW9. The rehaut is set at an angle, reflecting the luminous markers brilliantly at night. The DLC version features Diamond-Like Carbon coating, for enhanced scratch resistance.

The handset is lifted straight from the Flieger ‘Type A’ design of WWII, with version B of the Peregrine featuring the same triangle dots of the aforementioned vintage inspiration. Purpose-built for a life of adventure, the Peregrine will be your ever-present companion as you tackle the great outdoors. The crown is now on the left, bringing the power reserve indicator (PRI) to the bottom of the dial. The PRI is subtly executed, red = empty, white = full. Above this is a neatly and symmetrically positioned date window, with luminous text for improved night legibility. The dial itself is finished in a deep black for maximum contrast, while the applied indices receive a healthy dose of C3(X1) Super-LumiNova. The other white markers and numerals are printed in Super-LumiNova BGW9. The rehaut is set at an angle, reflecting the luminous markers brilliantly at night.
